headline: Mahindra & Mahindra Shares Surge 5% Following Q2 Results
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra shares rose 5% after its second-quarter earnings report. Its farm equipment EBIT margin reached 16.8%, while the automotive EBIT margin came in at 7.7%.
why: Mahindra & Mahindra is a leading Indian multinational automotive and farm equipment manufacturing corporation.

impacts.name: Mahindra & Mahindra
impacts.why: Strong earnings reports and margin performance directly lift the company's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong quarterly earnings and positive broker sentiment drove investor buying in M&M shares.
